Lemma
[hyperbolicity of noncollapsing limits] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 5.3.6\group Nonsingular Three-Dimensional Solutions

In Case $(3)$ where $R_{\min }\rightarrow -6$ as $t\rightarrow +\infty $, all noncollapsing limit are hyperbolic with constant sectional curvature $-1.$
